trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: SMC, FVG, and Trend Indicators. The H1 timeframe exhibits a massive bullish expansion candle at 13:00, creating a large unmitigated Fair Value Gap (FVG) between 78148.74 and 78815.84. This FVG represents a severe liquidity imbalance where market makers left unfilled buy orders. The H1, M15, and M5 EMAs are in strong bullish alignment, validating that any retracement into this FVG is a high-probability buy-limit entry zone (defensive staff) to catch the next leg of the trend.

Confluence 2: Quarter Theory, MSNR, and Volatility. The entry zone aligns perfectly with the 78500 minor quarter level and sits just above the 78000 psychological level. This area previously acted as a major resistance zone (MSNR) during the 08:00-11:00 H1 consolidation. The high M15 ATR of 570.40857 indicates significant volatility, ensuring that a rapid, preemptive wick-rejection is highly likely to tap our limit order at 78450.00 before reversing sharply.

Confluence 3: Fibonacci Retracement, Supply/Demand, and Momentum. Drawing a Fibonacci retracement from the swing low of 76046.58 to the swing high of 79890.00 places the 0.382 retracement level at 78421.80 and the 0.5 level at 77968.29. This golden ratio zone overlaps with a newly formed H1 demand zone. Although the M15 RSI is currently overbought at 75.1, a healthy corrective pullback into this demand zone will cool off momentum indicators while maintaining the structural integrity of the bullish trend.

Confluence 4: Break of Structure (BOS), Candlestick Patterns, and Volume. The aggressive breakout above the previous H4/H1 resistance levels at 77500 constitutes a major bullish Break of Structure (BOS). This structural shift was driven by high-volume expansion, as evidenced by the consecutive large-bodied bullish candles on the lower timeframes. The preemptive entry at 78450.00 targets the mitigation of this breakout point before the next expansion phase.

Confluence 5: Candle Range Theory (CRT), SMC Liquidity, and Standard Deviation. Under Candle Range Theory, the daily range has established its accumulation phase near 76800-77200, followed by a manipulation sweep down to 76046.58, and is now in the distribution phase. Standard deviation analysis shows the price expanded beyond +2SD on the H1 chart. A corrective mean-reversion to the defensive staff at 78450.00 will sweep internal sell-side liquidity before continuing the HTF expansion toward the 80000+ liquidity pools.

confidence_model.dominant_bias_reason: The bullish scenario scores 94.12% confidence due to strong multi-timeframe alignment (H1, M15, M5 are all bullish) and a clear, high-volume Break of Structure (BOS) that left behind a massive H1 Fair Value Gap (FVG). The bearish scenario, despite the H4 bearish trend and the rejection wick at 79890, only scores 70.58% because it lacks structural confirmation (no bearish BOS or bearish FVG has formed yet). Therefore, buying the retracement into the defensive staff at 78450.00 is the highly dominant, executable bias.
